Interface SulfurCubeArchetypeRegistryEntry.Builder

All Superinterfaces:
RegistryBuilder<SulfurCube.Archetype>, SulfurCubeArchetypeRegistryEntry
Enclosing interface:
SulfurCubeArchetypeRegistryEntry
@NonExtendable public static interface SulfurCubeArchetypeRegistryEntry.Builder extends SulfurCubeArchetypeRegistryEntry, RegistryBuilder<SulfurCube.Archetype>
A mutable builder for the SulfurCubeArchetypeRegistryEntry plugins may change in applicable registry events.

The following values are required for each builder:

  • items(RegistryKeySet)
  • knockbackModifiers(KnockbackModifiers)
  • soundSettings(SoundSettings)
